newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mabuhay sells 50 pct stake in power firm.
newsitem.headline: Mabuhay sells 50 pct stake in power firm.

text.p: Philippines' Mabuhay Holdings Corp said on Thursday it had sold 50 percent of its stake in Mactan Power Corp to East Asia Power Resources Corp for 187.553 million pesos.
The settlement of the purchase was expected to be done on or before December 31 this year, the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.

"Mabuhay has sold its interest...to raise liquidity, as part of a continuing restructuring, and to be able to take advantage of possible opportunities in its property-related activities," the company said.
Mabuhay has interests in real estate and hotel management companies while Mactan is a power generating firm.
